summary: Delivery probes and the Discord bridge accept FRACTAL_AGENT with the existing ST_AGENT fallback.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild is required.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The delivery probe and Discord bridge prefer FRACTAL_AGENT, retain ST_AGENT when the preferred variable is absent, and refuse unequal aliases when FRACTAL_AGENT is nonempty. An explicitly empty FRACTAL_AGENT masks ST_AGENT. Conflict errors name variables without disclosing identity values. Explicit Discord bridge actors retain precedence; X-St3-Person is unchanged. This extends arn:lmig:smalltalk:2026-10-16-env-fractal-dual-read without contracting legacy reads.

downtime.detail: No running deployment is changed by this commit.

manual.detail: Legacy-only environments continue to work. Configure aliases equally when setting both to nonempty identities.

recovery.detail: No state migration is performed. Previous scripts remain usable with ST_AGENT configured.
